zh.title: 摇操数据采集
zh.summary: 第一次接触遥操作，使用的是Meta Quest Pro，主要是利用了宇树开源的摇操代码，然后将摇操对象改为了UR30机械臂，完成了对UR30机械臂的摇操数据采集。

en.title: UR30 Teleoperation Data Collection
en.summary: This was my first experience with robot teleoperation. I used a Meta Quest Pro together with Unitree's open-source teleoperation code, adapted the original control target to a UR30 robot arm, and completed a teleoperation data-collection workflow for the UR30.

alt.zh: UR30 机械臂遥操作测试

alt.en: Teleoperation data collection for an apple-picking task
